note: 'Moses wrote down this law and gave it to the priests, the sons of Levi, who carried the ark of the covenant of the LORD' (Deut 31:9), and the book is put in the side of the ark at 31:26.; The Levites bear the ark that the book of the law is laid beside (Deut 31:9, 26).; 'the priests, the sons of Levi, who carried the ark'; 'carried the ark of God on their shoulders'
The whole of Deuteronomy 33, tribe by tribe.

'Then Moses called for Joshua and said to him in the presence of all Israel, Be strong and courageous, for you will go with this people into the land' (Deut 31:7). **In the sight of all Israel** -- the succession is public and the verse says so.

'So Moses the servant of the LORD died there in the land of Moab, as the LORD had said.' (Deut 34:5), and 'no one to this day knows the location of his grave' (34:6). **The book records that the burial place is unknown**, which is a different claim from not recording it.
'This is the blessing that Moses the man of God pronounced upon the Israelites before his death.' (Deut 33:1).

'Then Moses came with Joshua son of Nun and recited all the words of this song in the hearing of the people.' (Deut 32:44). **Joshua is named here by his old name**, which the book uses nowhere else after Numbers 13:16 renamed him.
